name: Xenocrates (uncertain which)
bio: The epigram on a statue of Hermes is ascribed to a Xenocrates whom Paton’s Index of Authors does not identify further.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XVI: 186.

poems.title: Book XVI, 186: On a Statue of Hermes
poems.author: Xenocrates (uncertain which)
poems.text: Hermes is my name, but in the wrestling-school set me not up without arms and feet; or how shall I be swift, and how shall I spar correctly, if I stand on a base deprived of both?
